cnc_joinery.philosophy: captured flat-pack joinery with CNC-located dados/rabbets and no builder freehand structural alignment
cnc_joinery.square_tab_relief_policy: use tool-radius-compatible shoulders or explicit dogbones only where required; no cosmetic-edge dogbones
cnc_joinery.production_rule: all groove widths and mating-tab values are regenerated from measured plywood thickness and the Cutter CNC tolerance coupon before release

leg_reinforcement.exact_leg_holes_status: BLOCKED until actual leg/bracket hardware is selected and measured
leg_reinforcement.rule: leg and retractable-wheel loads are backed by local plywood reinforcement and metal hardware; playing load remains on levelers

pc_drawer.architecture: internal fore-aft service drawer; service with playfield raised; tray remains inside cabinet during slide travel and lifts out after slide release
pc_drawer.fixed_load_path: drawer subrails tie into low crossmembers/bottom structure and are not screwed only into SSF-active sidewall skins
pc_drawer.exact_slide_holes_status: BLOCKED until the selected physical slide pair is measured

ssf_keepouts.rule: do not rigidly bridge left/right sidewalls across these zones with broad shelves; drawer subrails use independent crossmember/bottom load paths

playfield_glass.role: metric custom-cut local tempered-glass packaging target; final size follows siderail/lockdown prototype
playfield_glass.purchase_status: DO NOT ORDER until siderail and lockdown interfaces are proof-fitted

siderails.exact_profile_status: TBD after metal-shop consultation and glass mockup
siderails.rule: siderails retain/protect glass edges but are not relied upon as the sole cabinet structural tie

lockdown.exact_receiver_holes_status: BLOCKED until final lockdown/receiver concept is fabricated or selected
lockdown.rule: lockdown assembly positively retains the glass front and remains removable with ordinary service tools
